LESSON: SPELLING INSTRUCTION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Spelling instruction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Spelling instruction. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use proper letter formation with correct spacing to write words correctly
2. develop an interest in spelling and writing new words Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration- learners compete in spelling words in pairs and groups Links to PCIs: Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - Links to Values: Respect, responsibility effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas competitions bringing together learners from other schools in the community

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use proper letter formation with correct spacing to write words correctly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use proper letter formation with correct spacing to write words correctly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. develop an interest in spelling and writing new words Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration- learners compete in spelling words in pairs and groups Links to PCIs: Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - Links to Values: Respect, responsibility effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas competitions bringing together learners from other schools in the community
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in spelling and writing new words Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration- learners compete in spelling words in pairs and groups Links to PCIs: Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - Links to Values: Respect, responsibility effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas competitions bringing together learners from other schools in the community. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Spelling instruction using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Spelling instruction.
2. Explain Spelling instruction to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Spelling instruction.
4. Show that you can: use proper letter formation with correct spacing to write words correctly
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Spelling instruction. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Spelling instruction important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use proper letter formation with correct spacing to write words correctly
2. develop an interest in spelling and writing new words Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration- learners compete in spelling words in pairs and groups Links to PCIs: Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - Links to Values: Respect, responsibility effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas competitions bringing together learners from other schools in the community

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
